reason: MobileBERT is a directly relevant model-compression and inference-acceleration contribution for pretrained language models on mobile hardware, with measured Pixel 4 latency and size/speed gains. The full text identifies the model as bidirectional BERT used as a task encoder for fine-tuned NLP tasks, rather than an autoregressive generative LLM or its serving stack. It therefore sits at the boundary of the stated LLM inference scope and is retained as borderline.
title: MobileBERT: a Compact Task-Agnostic BERT for Resource-Limited Devices
